name: 3d-model-mcp
description: Local-first conversational CAD using MCP tools and OpenSCAD.

scripts.db:start: dotenv --no-expand -e apps/site/.env.local -- docker compose -f compose.local.yaml up --wait --wait-timeout 60 postgres
scripts.db:stop: dotenv --no-expand -e apps/site/.env.local -- docker compose -f compose.local.yaml stop postgres
scripts.db:logs: dotenv --no-expand -e apps/site/.env.local -- docker compose -f compose.local.yaml logs --follow postgres
scripts.auth:provision: pnpm build:packages && dotenv --no-expand -e apps/site/.env.local -- pnpm --filter @theoryfoundry/runtime auth:provision
scripts.build: pnpm prepare:browser-renderer && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @theoryfoundry/site build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @theoryfoundry/contracts build && pnpm --filter @theoryfoundry/model-project build && pnpm --filter @theoryfoundry/renderer build && pnpm --filter @theoryfoundry/mcp build && pnpm --filter @theoryfoundry/gateway build && pnpm --filter @theoryfoundry/runtime build
scripts.test: node --test scripts/database-shell.test.mjs && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter './packages/*' test && pnpm --filter @theoryfoundry/site test
scripts.verify: pnpm test:codex-installer && pnpm check:leaks && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm test:boundaries && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:leaks && pnpm check:boundaries
scripts.oauth:provision: pnpm build:packages && dotenv --no-expand -e apps/site/.env.local -- pnpm --filter @theoryfoundry/runtime oauth:provision
